notes: בְּקִרְבְּךָ is split three ways: the ASV writes a separate word for the preposition and for the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet; the suffix as nomen rectum takes the whole *of thee* under rule 19, headed on the pronoun.
אֶל of וְנָתַן אֵלֶיךָ is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing a bare English indirect object *give thee*; the suffix takes the object pronoun.
